experiment: CVRP selection-worthiness and CRC mechanism transfer v1
status: post-hoc exploratory offline replay; not new untouched test data; no deployment guarantee
pre_design_disclosures: Existing development summary and entire-table SBS/VBS headroom were inspected before freezing.
No selector or calibration performance was evaluated before this freeze.
input: 24 development instances; 432 prior real runs; 3 algorithms x 2 budget profiles x 3 solver seeds; no new solver or API calls
freeze_rule: Freeze this plan and all source/input hashes before first selector evaluation. No alpha changes after results.
primary_question: Is measured algorithm complementarity large enough to justify an actual pre-execution selector and its overhead?

split.group: all seeds and both profiles of a base instance share its role
split.strata: family x n customers only for split and reporting; not selector input

features: population std depot radius / mean depot radius
mean nearest-customer distance / mean depot radius

selector.target: per-algorithm mean route length over 3 seeds / star-route input-only upper bound
selector.tie_break: algorithm id lexicographic; neighbors distance then instance id

SBS: training-only minimum mean normalized length; no calibration/test labels used
oracle: per-instance minimum of 3-seed per-algorithm means, descriptive estimated-mean oracle; not mathematical optimum or true expected performance

CRC.sensitivity: predeclared illustration only; never replaces primary
CRC.loss: 1[chosen != train-SBS and score > lambda and chosen 3-seed mean length > 1.01 * train-SBS 3-seed mean length]
CRC.score: (predicted_SBS - predicted_chosen) / predicted_SBS; numerical ranking margin, NOT probability
CRC.calibration_rule: smallest nonnegative lambda satisfying (sum(calibration_losses)+1)/(n+1) <= alpha; if none return +infinity safe fallback
CRC.acceptance: strict score > lambda makes loss right-continuous and monotone nonincreasing
CRC.finite_candidates: 0 plus nonnegative calibration scores; else infinity
CRC.fallback: choose training SBS directly, without running alternative first
CRC.assumptions: finite bounded monotone losses and independent trained selector; expectation theorem requires exchangeable calibration/new points; this stratified historical development panel does not establish those assumptions
CRC.not_controlled: conditional accepted risk, individual-route safety, absolute path optimality, time/CPU utility, future distribution shift

failure_policy: stop if missing/duplicate input runs, invalid route, declared budget violation, cost/hash mismatch; never silently discard failures
accounting: prior solver/child CPU and wall remain attributed to original machine; new feature/training/calibration/inference/verification CPU/wall measured separately; no unsupported exact end-to-end wall claim
analysis: all 24 out-of-fold instances equal-weight, seeds nested; no p-values, no generalization or superiority claim; alpha sensitivity fully retained

paper_scope.P069: kNN cost-sensitive performance selection, train-SBS, split discipline; no SMAC/AutoFolio full-system reproduction
paper_scope.P116: formula and monotone binary-harm gate mechanism reimplementation; no original-paper datasets/results reproduction
paper_scope.P093: seed-mean versus lucky-seed oracle accounting application

safety: Do not alter original URP files, original sixty-request experiment, or execute supplied research/candidate code. Only own standard-library analysis runs.
